Come be Part of Our Story!

Who are We?

We are a well funded startup, Israel's largest deep-tech blockchain company and a global leader in blockchain infrastructure.

We'v developed technology that overcomes the blockchain industry’s key challenge: scalability.

By applying zero-knowledge proofs, with practical computer science applications, StarkWare enables tens of thousands of transactions per second with reduced costs, preserving security and privacy.
Its Layer 2 innovation, Starknet, operates on Ethereum, allowing developers to build decentralized, scalable, and cost-effective applications on the blockchain.

Together, we are not only rising to the challenge, we are redefining the paradigm.
